description: This file defines functions, classes, and templates related to leak checking and leak sanitizer control within the Abseil C++ library, specifically for LeakSanitizer and AddressSanitizer integration.

classes.name: LeakCheckDisabler
classes.description: Helper class to disable leak checking within a scope, preventing reported leaks for heap allocations made during its lifetime.

methods.name: IgnoreLeak
methods.description: Template function to instruct the leak sanitizer to ignore leaks on a specific pointer.

methods.name: LeakCheckDisabler
methods.description: Constructor and destructor to disable leak checking within a scope.
